title: allocation
description: Reusable allocation data block for one balancing group, one location and one flow direction.

flowDirection.description: Flow direction of the allocation block. Entry represents a flow into the relevant network or balancing group. Exit represents a flow out of the relevant network or balancing group.

x-enumDescriptions.Entry: Flow into the relevant network, system or balancing group.
x-enumDescriptions.Exit: Flow out of the relevant network, system or balancing group.

values.description: Ordered time series containing one value for each consecutive interval of the allocation block. The interval duration is defined by allocationData.granularity.
